cases.prompt: The pagination tests are failing. Hand this to a debugging subagent to find the root cause and fix it.
expectations: Fixes the off-by-one in paginate.js at its root cause
Adds or keeps a regression test that fails without the fix

cases.prompt: The pagination tests are failing. Please fix it.
expectations: Fixes the off-by-one in paginate.js at its root cause, with a regression test or existing failing tests that cover it, and the tests pass
Record whether the work was delegated to kit-debugger or done by the main agent (with or without kit-debugging); either is acceptable

cases.prompt: Sometimes paginate returns an empty array in production for page 2. Have a debugging subagent fix it.
expectations: Reports that the failure does not reproduce and what was tried
Does not make a speculative change to paginate.js
